larosa023/hangar.name: Hangar v0.1.5
larosa023/hangar.body:
## Hangar 0.1.5

**No more "GitHub limit reached".** Without a GitHub sign-in, GitHub allows only 60 release checks an hour, and Hangar was using 22 per refresh while sharing that budget with your apps' own updaters. Now:
- A job in the Hangar repo collects every app's releases into one file every 10 minutes.
- Hangar downloads that one file, which isn't counted against the limit, instead of calling GitHub once per app.
- If the file is ever missing or out of date, Hangar falls back to asking GitHub directly, as before.

Downloads are still verified against each release's SHA-256.

**Isle** has joined the library under Windows replacements.

larosa023/hangar.name: Hangar v0.1.4
larosa023/hangar.body:
## Hangar 0.1.4

**Themes.** A new **Themes** page in the sidebar has 14 themes with live previews. Click one and it changes right away.
- **Dark, Light,** and **Windows** (follows Windows light/dark mode)
- **Midnight:** pure black for OLED screens
- **Glass:** see-through over your wallpaper (Windows 11)
- **Frost, Twilight, Forest, Sunset, Ocean, Rose, Graphite**
- **Paper** and **Mist:** two softer light themes

**Accent color:** the theme's own, your Windows accent, 9 swatches, or any custom color.

**Theme files:** save the current look as a `.json` file to tweak or share it. Any theme files you drop in the themes folder show up in the gallery. See docs/THEMES.md for the format.

larosa023/hangar.name: Hangar v0.1.3
larosa023/hangar.body:
## Hangar 0.1.3

### Fixed
- **An app could keep showing "Update available" right after updating.** If an app's exe still carried an old version number in its file properties, Hangar believed the old number. Hangar now remembers exactly which release it installed and trusts that as long as the file hasn't changed. (Foyer 0.2.0 was the first app to hit this.)
- **Apps you downloaded but never "installed" now show as installed.** Hangar now also looks in your Downloads folder and on your Desktop, including renamed copies like `Breaker (1).exe`. It only accepts an exe whose file properties name the app or larosa023, so an unrelated file with a similar name is never picked up.

### Also
- Hangar's own version number is now stamped into Hangar.exe automatically on every build.

larosa023/hangar.name: Hangar v0.1.2
larosa023/hangar.body:
## Hangar 0.1.2

**Hangar now updates itself.**
- It checks GitHub for new versions of Hangar in the background: about 20 seconds after it opens, then on the same interval as app checks (every 3 hours by default).
- New versions download and are SHA-256 verified quietly. When one is ready, the sidebar shows **Restart to update**.
- Restarting takes about a second, and you land on the same page with the same search and scroll position. A short "What's new" note appears afterwards.
- **Automatic installs** wait until Hangar is minimized or you've been away from the PC for 2 minutes. Hangar never updates itself while it's installing apps.
- **Safe:** if a new version doesn't start, Hangar puts the old one back by itself and skips that version.
- **Roll back** to either of the last 2 versions from Settings → Hangar updates.
- **Stable or Beta** channel for Hangar itself, and auto-install can be turned off.

You need to download this version by hand once. From here on, Hangar keeps itself up to date.

larosa023/hangar.name: Hangar v0.1.1
larosa023/hangar.body:
## Hangar 0.1.1

**Finds your apps wherever they are.** Before, Hangar only looked in each app's standard install folder, so apps you run from somewhere else showed "Install". Now it also checks:
- apps that are running right now
- startup entries (the Windows "Run" list) and Start menu, desktop and taskbar shortcuts
- common folders: `%LOCALAPPDATA%\<App>`, `%APPDATA%\<App>`, `Program Files`
- Apps & features entries whose icon isn't the exe (fixes Gridline)

Hangar checks each exe's version info so it doesn't mistake another program with the same file name for one of yours, and it remembers where each app was found. If an app still isn't found, open its page and click **Already installed? Locate it**.

larosa023/hangar.name: Hangar v0.1.0
larosa023/hangar.body:
## Hangar 0.1.0 (Phase 1)

The first build of Hangar, home base for the larosa023 apps.

- **Library** of all 21 apps in the suite, in a grid or a list, with categories, search (Ctrl+K) and keyboard navigation. It opens straight away from a cache, then refreshes in the background.
- **Shows what's installed and running**, including apps you installed before Hangar existed.
- **Release checks** against each app's GitHub Releases, on the Stable or Beta channel, with very little use of GitHub's rate limit.
- **One-click Install, Open, Update, Repair and Uninstall.** It handles single-exe apps, NSIS setups (Electron and Tauri apps) and Velopack setups.
- **Verified downloads:** SHA-256 against GitHub's digest and the app's own checksum file.
- **Updating an open app:** Hangar closes it the normal way, updates it, and reopens it. If the new version doesn't start, the previous one comes back.
- **Update all**, a page per app with release history, and Settings (theme, default channel, check interval, local manifest).

larosa023/foyer.name: Foyer v0.2.2
larosa023/foyer.body:
## Foyer 0.2.2

### Fixed
- **Apps without a Start menu shortcut now show up.** Windows only lists apps that have a Start menu shortcut, so portable apps run from Downloads, Documents or a tools folder were missing from both Foyer and the Windows Start menu. Foyer now also lists every larosa023 app that Hangar knows about, wherever it lives, with its proper name and icon. Search, pinning, Run as administrator and Open file location all work for them.

larosa023/foyer.name: Foyer v0.2.1
larosa023/foyer.body:
## Foyer 0.2.1

### Fixed
- **Hangar kept offering the 0.2.0 update after installing it.** The 0.2.0 exe still said "0.1.0" in its file properties, which Windows and Hangar read. The version is now stamped into the exe automatically on every build, so this can't happen again.

### How to update
Click **Update** on Foyer in Hangar, or let Foyer's built-in updater install it.

larosa023/foyer.name: Foyer v0.2.0
larosa023/foyer.body:
## Foyer 0.2.0

### New
- **Settings window** — General, Appearance, Layout, Apps, Updates and About pages. Changes apply instantly, with a live preview of the menu.
- **Built-in updater** — checks GitHub Releases, verifies every download with SHA-256, installs with one click (or automatically), and rolls back by itself if a new version fails to start. Stable and Beta channels. Never interrupts games or fullscreen video.
- **Themes** — Follow Windows, Dark, Light, Midnight (pure black), Glass, Ember and Ocean, plus an accent color picker.
- **Acrylic and Mica** backgrounds with adjustable tint, and adjustable corner radius.
- **Layouts** — Modern (pinned grid + All apps), Classic (single column) and Full screen (launcher overlay). Choose position, density and icon size.
- **Motion** — slide-in open, staggered tiles, smooth hover fades, press feedback, smooth scrolling and tooltips. Turn it down to Fast or None any time.
- **Greeting** with your name and today's date, and a soft accent glow.
- **Backup and restore** of all settings to one file.

### How to update from 0.1.0
0.1.0 has no updater yet: quit Foyer from the tray, then run this Foyer.exe. From 0.2.0 on, updates install themselves.

larosa023/strata.name: Strata v0.3.0
larosa023/strata.body:
## Strata 0.3.0

**Made for bid folders**
- **Version stacking:** `Plans_rev1.pdf`, `Plans_rev2.pdf` and `Plans rev 3.pdf` collapse into one row that shows the newest, with a **"3 versions"** pill. Click the pill, or press **→**, to see the older versions underneath. It understands rev/R/v numbers, revision letters (Rev B), dates (`_2026-03-01`), `(2)` and `- Copy`. Sheet numbers like `A-101` are left alone. You can turn it off in Settings → Layout.
- **What changed (Ctrl+Shift+H):** every file in this folder and its subfolders that changed **since your last visit**, today, in the last 7 or 30 days, or since a date. Newest files come first. Esc goes back.
- **Space view (Ctrl+Shift+S, or the 4th view button):** a treemap of what's using space, colored by kind (drawings, PDFs and Office files, video, images, archives). Double-click a folder to look inside. On This PC it shows your drives. Every folder and drive also has "Show what's using space" on its right-click menu.

**Everyday speed**
- **Quick look carousel:** press **Space** for a big preview, then use ← → to flip through files. Enter opens the file; Space or Esc closes the preview.
- **Jump to folder (Ctrl+G):** a fuzzy search over the folders you use, ranked by how often and how recently you opened them. Type "smi bid" to reach `D:\Bids\2026\Smith Library`. Ctrl+Enter opens it in a new tab, Shift+Enter in the other pane. Grid view moved to **Ctrl+Shift+G**.
- **Focus filter (Ctrl+Shift+F):** show only PDFs, drawings, Office files, images, files changed this week, files with a given tag, or the same type as the selection. The filter stays on while you browse; Esc or ✕ turns it off.
- **Tabs that stick:** right-click a tab → **Lock tab to this folder**. Folders you open from a locked tab open in a new tab. Right-click a tab → **Tab color** to color it.

**Polish**
- **Smooth animations:** the active tab and the active pane's accent bar slide, the sidebar and preview slide in and out, and folders fade in. Choose None / Fast / Smooth in Settings → Layout; Strata also follows Windows' "Animation effects" setting.
- **Themed dialogs:** replace/skip conflicts, delete confirmations, update notes, uninstall and name prompts now use your theme instead of plain Windows boxes. The batch rename window is themed too.
- **Sounds and notifications:** when a copy or move that took longer than 10 seconds finishes, Strata plays a soft chime and shows a card with **Open folder**. If Strata isn't in front, you get a Windows notification instead. You can turn both off in Settings → File operations.

larosa023/strata.name: Strata v0.2.2
larosa023/strata.body:
## Strata 0.2.2

- **Rearrange the sidebar:** drag pinned folders, drives, tags and saved searches to reorder them, or drag a section header (Pinned, Drives, Tags, Saved searches, Recent) to move the whole section. A line shows where it will land. Right-click also has **Move up / Move down**, and right-clicking a header offers **Reset sidebar order**.
- The order, and which sections are collapsed, are remembered.
- Drive roots in **Recent** now show their name and icon ("Data3 (F:)") instead of just "F:".

Also in 0.2.1: the ghost minimize / maximize / close buttons behind Strata's title bar with Mica or Acrylic are gone.

larosa023/strata.name: Strata v0.2.1
larosa023/strata.body:
## Strata 0.2.1

- **Fixed for real:** the faint "ghost" minimize / maximize / close buttons behind Strata's own when the Mica or Acrylic background is on. Windows was drawing its own caption buttons into the see-through title bar; Strata now tells Windows not to draw them at all (the same fix Firefox uses). Snap layouts on the maximize button, Alt+Space and Alt+F4 keep working.

larosa023/strata.name: Strata v0.2.0
larosa023/strata.body:
## Strata 0.2.0 — the big one

Everything from the remaining roadmap phases lands in this release.

**Dual pane & keyboard**
- Dual-pane layout (default) with **Tab** to switch panes, **F5** copy / **F6** move to the other pane, and a view switch for dual, single, and grid.
- Grid view with thumbnails. Strata remembers sort order, view, and columns for each folder.
- Columns adapt to narrow panes.

**Transfers**
- Strata's own transfer queue: pause, resume, cancel, and skip, with speed and ETA. **Ctrl+J** opens the transfers panel.
- Optional SHA-256 **verify after copy**. Strata warns when the destination is low on space and lets you set a default for name conflicts.
- **Ctrl+Z undo** for rename, move, copy, new folder, and delete (deleted items come back from the Recycle Bin).
- **Batch rename:** press F2 with several items selected. You can find and replace (with optional regex), add a prefix or suffix, number items, and change case, with a live preview. Ctrl+Z undoes the whole batch.
- Drag and drop between panes, tabs, the sidebar, and other apps.

**Folder sizes & tags**
- Folder sizes are calculated in the background, with size bars. This pauses while you're gaming or the CPU is busy.
- Color tags on files and folders: Urgent, Active, Done, and Repo, plus your own. Click a tag in the sidebar to see everything with that tag.

**Search**
- Search uses **Everything** if it's running; otherwise it uses Strata's own whole-PC index, which rebuilds in the background.
- Filters: `type:pdf`, `ext:dwg`, `size:>50mb`, `modified:7d`, `modified:2026-03`, `tag:urgent`, `folder:`, and `file:`.
- **Saved searches** become smart folders in the sidebar.

**Preview panel** (Ctrl+P, or Space for a quick look)
- Images, text and code, PDF, Office files, and video through the Windows preview handlers.
- File details, plus "what's taking space" for folders.
- **Git status** (branch, changes, ahead/behind), with buttons for Open and Open in other pane.

**Archives:** browse into .zip files like folders, and extract with drag-out or **Extract here**.

**Right-click menu:** a cleaner menu that hides clutter you choose (hold **Shift** to see everything), plus Open in other pane, Calculate size, Copy path, Open terminal, and Add tag.

**Settings window** (Ctrl+,): General, Layout, Themes, Search, Tags, File operations, Updates, and About.
- Theme presets and a custom theme with live preview, plus accent color, Mica or Acrylic backdrop, font, size, corner radius, and density.
- Theme files can be imported and exported, and are compatible with Foyer.

**System**
- **Built-in updater:** Stable and Beta channels, SHA-256 check, and automatic rollback if a new version fails to start. It never installs during a transfer or while you're gaming. Future versions install themselves.
- Install to `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs` (Start menu entry, uninstall from Apps) or run in portable mode.
- Start with Windows, with a tray icon and close to tray.
- Optional **default file manager** (folders and Win+E open in Strata) with a safe fallback. If Strata crashes or hangs, folders open in File Explorer, and `Strata.exe --restore-explorer` undoes it.
- Back up and restore settings, pins, tags, and folder views as one file.
- Respects Windows high-contrast mode and text scaling.

larosa023/strata.name: Strata v0.1.1
larosa023/strata.body:
## Strata 0.1.1

- **Search everything from This PC:** typing in the search box on This PC now searches every drive. If [Everything](https://www.voidtools.com/) is running, results are instant; otherwise Strata scans in the background at low priority and shows results as it finds them.
- **Search subfolders:** in any folder, typing still filters instantly; press **Enter** to search that folder and all its subfolders.
- Search results show a **Location** column, can be sorted, opened, renamed, copied, cut and deleted, and the right-click menu has **Open file location**.
- **Fixed:** faint "ghost" minimize / maximize / close buttons behind Strata's own when using the Mica or Acrylic background.

larosa023/strata.name: Strata v0.1.0
larosa023/strata.body:
## Strata 0.1.0 — Phase 1

First test build.

- Custom window with browser-style folder tabs (reorder, duplicate, reopen closed with Ctrl+Shift+T) and Windows 11 snap layouts on the maximize button
- Toolbar with back / forward / up / refresh, a clickable breadcrumb path bar with sibling-folder dropdowns, and type-a-path mode (Ctrl+L)
- Instant filter for the current folder (Ctrl+K), with wildcards
- Sidebar with This PC, pinned folders (color tags, reorder) and drives with free-space bars
- Virtualized file list: Name / Size / Modified / Type, sortable and resizable, choose columns; smooth scrolling; box selection; type-ahead
- Open, copy, cut, paste (interoperates with File Explorer), rename in place, delete to Recycle Bin, permanent delete, new folder / text file
- Full Windows right-click menu plus Open in new tab, Pin to sidebar, Open terminal here, Copy path
- Folders refresh automatically when their contents change
- Themes from the suite (Dark, Light, Midnight, Glass, Ember, Ocean, Follow Windows) with Solid / Mica / Acrylic backgrounds
- Remembers tabs, window size, columns and sort order

larosa023/breaker.name: Breaker v1.0.0
larosa023/breaker.body:
## Breaker 1.0.0

The first release: a fast replacement for Windows Settings and Control Panel.

- **Every setting in one place:** System, Devices, Network, Personalization, Apps, Gaming, Accounts, Privacy & Security, Windows Update, Debloat and Advanced, each explained in plain English with a recommended value where it helps.
- **Search as you type** (Ctrl+K) across every setting and Control Panel item, with synonyms.
- **Undo for everything:** a history of every change with one-click revert, Ctrl+Z, and "restore everything to how it was on a date".
- **Profiles** (Gaming, Work, Battery Saver, Presentation, or your own) that apply in one click or switch by themselves.
- **Update watchdog:** tells you when Windows changes a setting you chose, and puts it back.
- **Snapshots:** save every setting to a file and apply it to a fresh install or another PC.
- **Themes** shared with Foyer and Strata, plus **My Apps** to launch, configure and update the rest of the suite.
- Built-in updater (Stable and Beta, verified downloads, automatic rollback), installer or portable mode, tray icon, and an optional Win+I shortcut.

Windows may show a SmartScreen warning the first time because the exe isn't code-signed: **More info → Run anyway**.

larosa023/switch.name: Switch v0.2.0
larosa023/switch.body:
**New**
- List layout with a large live preview of the selected window, alongside Grid and Row. Ctrl+L cycles layouts
- Fuzzy search with highlighted matches ("vsc" finds Visual Studio Code); results are ranked by match quality
- Alt+` switches between windows of the current app
- Grouping now has three modes: Off, Together and Collapse (one tile per app with a count badge). Ctrl+G cycles them
- Right-click menu (and the Menu key) with every window action
- New window actions: maximize/restore, move to the next or previous monitor, close every window of an app, open a new window, open the file location
- Optional windows from other virtual desktops, marked with a badge
- Optional desktop dimming behind the switcher
- Sort by recent, app or title; start on the previous or the current window; wrap-around toggle
- Open on the cursor's monitor, the active window's monitor or the primary monitor
- Select-on-hover and action-button toggles
- Keyboard hint bar, PgUp/PgDn, and Ctrl+Backspace to clear the search

**Settings**
- Redesigned settings window with sidebar pages: General, Shortcuts, Appearance, Layout, Windows, Hidden apps, Updates, About
- Live preview of the switcher on the Appearance and Layout pages
- Pure Black theme, custom hex accent color, corner radius, text size, selection style, animation speed (Off/Fast/Normal/Relaxed), position (center/top/bottom), labels (title/app/both), icon and search-bar visibility
- Sliders for preview size, quick-switch delay, corner radius and dim strength
- Hidden apps page: hide running apps with one click, or add any app by file name
- "Release Alt to switch" can be turned off so every session stays open
- Updates page shows release notes and when the last check ran; optional automatic install; notifications can be turned off
- About page with live memory usage, log and settings shortcuts, and reset to defaults
- Restart as administrator, a master on/off switch, and a choice of what clicking the tray icon does

**Faster and lighter**
- Animations are paced by the compositor (DwmFlush) for smooth motion at any refresh rate, and add a subtle zoom on open
- Idle memory goes back to Windows 10 seconds after the switcher closes
- The panel is sized once per session, so typing never resizes it

**Other**
- `--settings` and `--quit` command-line options
- Settings from 0.1 migrate automatically

larosa023/downtime.name: Downtime v0.4.0
larosa023/downtime.body:
31 games (16 new): Yukon, Scorpion, Forty Thieves, Canfield, Kakuro, Fifteen, Lights Out, Pipes, Word Guess, Word Search, Chess, Checkers, Reversi, Pong, Rocks and Flapper.
Daily puzzles: Sudoku, Nonograms, Mahjong and Word Guess each get one a day, tracked with a streak calendar on the new Today page.
46 trophies, which pop up when you unlock one.
Card games: Hint (or the H key), plus a Finish button that plays out the rest.
Favorites and sidebar: a star on any game, a recently played row, collapsible sidebar groups and a compact icon-only sidebar.
Mini player: the button in a game’s top bar, or the M key, shrinks it to a small window that stays on top of other apps.
Look: Mint, Dusk and High contrast themes, a custom accent color, 2 new card backs, a four-color deck and large-print cards.
Sound: a volume slider and on/off switches for each type of sound.

larosa023/downtime.name: Downtime v0.3.0
larosa023/downtime.body:
Added:

Mahjong: clear a stacked board of 108 tiles by matching free pairs. Every board can be cleared. Press H for a hint. If you run out of open pairs, the leftover tiles shuffle automatically.
Golf: a quick solitaire. Play the bottom card of a column if it’s one higher or lower than the open card.
Nonograms: picture logic puzzles in 5×5, 10×10 and 15×15. Each one can be solved without guessing. Drag to fill cells, and right-click to mark an X.
Connect Four: play against the computer on Easy, Normal or Hard. You and the computer take turns going first. Hard took the first game I played against it.
Memory: classic card matching with 8, 12 or 18 pairs.

larosa023/rigcard.name: Rigcard v1.0.0
larosa023/rigcard.body:
## Rigcard 1.0.0

The first release: your PC build as one clean, shareable card.

- **Detects your hardware by itself**: CPU, GPU and VRAM, motherboard and BIOS, memory (size, speed, modules), drives, monitors, keyboard and mouse, Windows version. Rescan any time to see what changed.
- **Parts Windows can't see**: search-as-you-type picker for coolers, power supplies, cases, fans and peripherals, or type anything.
- **Live stats**: CPU and GPU temperature, clocks, load, power draw and uptime, read only while the window is open.
- **Benchmarks**: quick CPU single and multi-core, GPU compute, memory bandwidth and latency, storage read, write and 4K tests, with history. Import 3DMark, CrystalDiskMark, Geekbench and Cinebench scores.
- **Card design**: 10 styles, full color, font, layout and corner control, photo cropping, blurred photo backgrounds. Save and share styles as JSON.
- **Export** PNGs for Discord and Reddit, square posts, Instagram portrait, phone wallpapers and 4K. Copy the image straight to the clipboard.
- **Share links**: an instant quick link, or a hosted page (a secret gist on your GitHub) that updates when your build does, with optional live stats.
- **Privacy**: serial numbers, IP address, user name and location stay off the card unless you turn them on.
- Themes shared with the rest of the suite, live theme changes from Hangar, a built-in updater with Stable and Beta channels, hash-verified downloads and automatic rollback.

larosa023/outpost.name: Outpost v1.0.3
larosa023/outpost.body:
## Outpost 1.0.3

- Smooth scrolling and animations at your monitor's full refresh rate (60, 144, 165 Hz…). Outpost now draws in step with the screen instead of on a timer that topped out around 64 frames a second and stuttered against the display. Movement uses real elapsed time, so it feels the same on any monitor.
- Snappier scroll easing.
- The tray tooltip is only updated when it changes.
- If a frame ever takes too long to draw, Outpost notes it in outpost.log (Settings → About → Log file) to help track it down.

larosa023/outpost.name: Outpost v1.0.2
larosa023/outpost.body:
## Outpost 1.0.2

- Much smoother scrolling and hovering everywhere, especially in Settings: text layouts are now built once and reused, and text that's scrolled out of view isn't drawn at all.
- Fixed: in Outpost settings, the "a backup fails" switch was drawn on top of "a player joins". The three notification switches now each have their own row.
- Fixed: the UPnP switch in a server's Network settings could sit in the wrong place when its description wrapped.

larosa023/outpost.name: Outpost v1.0.1
larosa023/outpost.body:
## Outpost 1.0.1

- Settings pages are much smoother: text measurements are cached, and slow checks (old versions, Windows colors, Hangar) run every few seconds instead of every frame. Scrolling past switches no longer slows the app down over time.
- Outpost redraws only when something under the mouse changes.
- On wide or full-screen windows, Outpost settings, the new server wizard and each server's Settings tab are centered in a readable column.
- Fixed: the "you're playing a game" notice could appear when Outpost itself filled the screen.
- Fixed: Paper/Fabric config folders (like bStats or spark) were listed as plugins.
- The Restore button in the backup card no longer spills out of the card on narrow windows.

larosa023/outpost.name: Outpost v1.0.0
larosa023/outpost.body:
## Outpost 1.0.0

The first release: one-click game servers for Windows.

- **12 games**: Minecraft Java (Vanilla, Paper, Fabric, Forge, NeoForge), Minecraft Bedrock, Valheim, Palworld, Terraria, Satisfactory, Project Zomboid, Enshrouded, ARK: Survival Ascended, Rust, Counter-Strike 2 and 7 Days to Die. SteamCMD and Java are handled for you.
- **New server wizard**, import an existing server or world, any number of servers per game.
- **Live console** with colors, command history and autocomplete; players, CPU, RAM and TPS/FPS.
- **Players**: kick, ban, op, whitelist with buttons; join/leave history.
- **Mods**: Modrinth (and CurseForge with your key) for Minecraft, with compatibility checks and one-click updates; mod folders for other games; enable/disable without deleting.
- **Backups** on a schedule and on demand, keep the last N, any folder (an external drive or OneDrive), one-click restore with a safety backup first.
- **Networking**: UPnP port forwarding, Windows Firewall rules, NAT and reachability checks, router steps when UPnP isn't there, hide-my-IP, optional DuckDNS address.
- **Runs in the background**: servers keep running when Outpost closes or updates; auto-restart on crash, scheduled restarts, sleep when empty and wake on join.
- Themes from the suite (Dark, Light, Midnight, Glass and more), accent colors, density, corners, font size; live themes from Hangar.
- Built-in updater with Stable and Beta channels, verified downloads and automatic rollback.
